testcase.name: replay is opt-in, idempotent, and preserves unrelated files
successive updates accept original and verified predecessors, never custom edits
invalid predecessor lists and predecessors on additions are rejected
guarded additions create only absent files and replay idempotently
guarded additions refuse existing custom files and symlinks
preflight rejects custom edits before changing another file
invalid hashes, traversal, duplicates, and symlinks fail closed
